vm-bot.note: The reviewer stub, installed at boot into the VM's synced deploy tree (entrypoint.sh.j2) and kept by the sync's anchored exclude.

vm-lens.note: A lens child runs in its parent's cwd (extensions/subagents.ts strips every cwd param) with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

daemon-bot.note: The full AGENTS.md: the entrypoint refuses to install the stub because this root is the operator's own checkout.

daemon-lens.note: A lens child runs in its parent's cwd (extensions/subagents.ts strips every cwd param) with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

bench.note: The same stub as production, copied into the image's cwd (bench/aacr/Dockerfile).

bench-lens.note: A lens child runs in its parent's cwd (extensions/subagents.ts strips every cwd param) with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

bench-judge.note: Runs in the PR's own checkout, whose AGENTS.md must not reach the judge.

clone-review.note: cwd is the run's own out dir under the state home, outside every checkout, holding a copy of the reviewer stub (src/hostroute.ts); the agentDir is a private one with no context file.

clone-review-lens.note: A lens child runs in its parent's cwd (extensions/subagents.ts strips every cwd param) with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

scan-leaf-container.note: cwd is the app root in the scan container (QCR_ROOT=/opt/qcr), which the companion image fills with an explicit COPY list that has no context file. The leaf passes -nc besides: it loads none whatever the root holds.

scan-leaf-host.note: [scan] sandbox = "host": cwd is sandboxRoot(), the qcr checkout, whose AGENTS.md the leaf does not load (-nc, P1.1); nothing is written there or into the scanned tree.

companion.note: /workspace is the qcr checkout, bind-mounted; no stub.
